eventDefinition: Recorded British coal-mine explosions involving ten or more fatalities; dataset dates in years, 1851 through 1962.
sourceQualification: Mutable upstream URLs with frozen exact acquired bytes. All 191 CSV doubles were matched to the boot R object in coal-candidate-checks.json; equal recorded dates stay distinct records.
exposureQualification: Explicit analysis bins, not a claim that first/last event establish complete surveillance boundaries. Descriptive calculations do not identify causal safety effects.
